description: Searches the ניירת rulebook: 571 Israeli state rules as code (tax, National Insurance, labour law, benefits, business, forms, deadlines), each tied to the law, a plain statement, conditions, the method, verified values with official sources and worked examples. Search in Hebrew or English ("פיצויי פיטורים", "severance", "נקודות זיכוי לחייל משוחרר"). Then get_rule for the full rule, calculate or evaluate for numbers.
name: find_rules
title: Find Israeli rules (rulebook)
